name: adas-trail-desktop
author: Niclas Lindstedt <niclas@agilator.se>
description: Desktop (Electron) Steam wrapper around the Ada's Trail PWA — bundles the game on-device and serves it from a private scheme, plus Steam Cloud saves and achievements.

scripts.build: npm run server && npm run modtools && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.dist: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/bundle-web.mjs --profile production && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.release:win: node scripts/bundle-web.mjs --profile production && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/bundle-web.mjs --profile production && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.release:linux: node scripts/bundle-web.mjs --profile production && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
